name: manual_327192
claim: A test stand-in that replaces a production primitive must be labelled as a stand-in where it is defined, and a second test must prove the real primitive against issuer-produced vectors

decisions.notes: 2026-10-22: the section 3.3 model used a pure Ed25519 signer without saying so; the Ed25519ph adapter test closed the gap
